keyFindings.title: Resolver and capability caches are process-local maps. `capabilityCache` maps binary path to an in-flight or completed promise at `mcp server/src/core/capabilities.ts:163,348-386`. The resolver maps tool name to a `CacheEntry` and in-flight lookup at `mcp server/src/core/ffmpeg-resolver.ts:446-449`. Resolver hits are revalidated against file existence, size, and modification time at lines 467-485. Tests already cover capability reuse and invalidation at `mcp server/tests/core/capabilities.vitest.ts:349-420`, plus resolver reuse and size or mtime changes at `mcp server/tests/core/ffmpeg-resolver.vitest.ts:809-861`. A one-shot CLI process loses these maps on exit. Persist only validated metadata under the data directory, using atomic writes and a versioned schema. Cache keys should include platform, architecture, config overrides, PATH identity, and data directory. Re-stat cached binaries on each process start, retain pinned install hash checks for installed binaries at `mcp server/src/core/ffmpeg-resolver.ts:552-584`, do not persist misses, and invalidate on setup or failure. These persistence details are recommendations.

keyFindings.title: Signal handling needs a CLI-specific cancellation path. The MCP entry catches SIGINT and SIGTERM and closes the server at `mcp server/src/index.ts:56-88`. The process runner starts a local child in `spawnAndWait` at `mcp server/src/core/process-runner.ts:360-374`, and only its timeout path kills that child with a grace period at lines 466-479. `withTempDir` removes its folder in `finally` at lines 687-702. Proposed CLI behavior: a shared abort controller stops active children, the CLI awaits dispatch settlement so tool `finally` cleanup runs, then it exits with documented statuses. This process registry and signal-to-cancellation path are recommendations, not existing runtime behavior.

keyFindings.title: The preferred skill invocation is an explicit `node` command whose script path contains `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`, for example `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/server/dist/cli.js"`. Claude Code substitutes `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` in plugin skill Markdown and in the skill's `allowed-tools` rules. It is not an environment variable available to commands launched by the Bash tool. Use the same substituted command pattern in both the allowed-tools rule and skill body so the bundled CLI path is exact. These behaviors are documented in the [Claude Code skills guide](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) and [Claude Code plugin manifest reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference).
